units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 4) remuneration and other payments in accordance with this Federal Law, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and the service contract;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 5) receipt, in the prescribed manner, of information and materials necessary to perform official duties, and submission of proposals to improve the state body's activities;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 6) access, in the prescribed manner, to information constituting state secrets if the performance of official duties involves the use of such information;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 7) access, in the prescribed manner, to state bodies, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organizations in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 8) access to appraisals of their professional service activity and other documents before inclusion in their personnel file, access to personnel file materials, and inclusion of their written explanations and other documents and materials in that file;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 9) protection of information about the civil servant;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 10) career advancement on a competitive basis;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 11) professional development in the manner established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 12) membership of a trade union;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 13) consideration of individual service disputes in accordance with this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 14) an internal service inquiry at their request;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 15) protection of their rights and lawful interests in the civil service, including judicial challenge of violations;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 16) medical insurance in accordance with this Federal Law and the federal law on medical insurance for state servants of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 17) state protection of their life and health, the life and health of their family members, and their property;
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 18) state pension provision in accordance with federal law.
units.label: Point 18 Part 1 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 14. Basic rights of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant may perform other paid work after prior notification of the employer's representative, provided this does not result in a conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 14

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 1) observe the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and the constitutions (charters), laws and other normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and ensure their implementation;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 2) perform official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 3) carry out instructions of the relevant managers issued within their powers established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 4) respect the rights and lawful interests of citizens and organizations when performing official duties;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 5) observe the state body's service rules;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 6) maintain the professional level necessary for proper performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 7) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens' private lives or health or affecting their honour and dignity;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 8) safeguard state property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 9) submit, in the prescribed manner, information about themselves and their family members required by federal law;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 10) notify the employer's representative in writing of termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation, acquisition of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign State, or receipt of a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen's right to permanent residence in a foreign State, on the day the civil servant learns of it, but no later than five working days after that termination, acquisition or receipt;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 11) observe restrictions, fulfil obligations and requirements concerning official conduct, and not breach prohibitions established by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 12) notify the employer's representative of a personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 13) notify the employer's representative in writing of changes that become known to the civil servant in the information in the questionnaire provided for by Article 20.3 of this Federal Law, except information changed by a decision of the employer's representative (hereinafter information contained in the questionnaire).
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 1.1. A civil servant must state monetary values in accordance with requirements established by federal laws and decrees of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant may not carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. On receiving an instruction from the relevant manager which the civil servant considers unlawful, the civil servant must submit a written explanation of its unlawfulness, specifying the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation that may be violated by carrying it out, and obtain written confirmation of the instruction from the manager. If the manager confirms the instruction in writing, the civil servant must refuse to carry it out.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 3. If a civil servant carries out an unlawful instruction, the civil servant and the manager who issued it bear disciplinary, civil, administrative or criminal liability in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 4. To exclude a conflict of interest in a state body, a civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category of the highest group of civil service positions may not represent civil servants' interests in that state body's elected trade union body while holding that position.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 15. Basic duties of a civil servant
units.text: 5. Civil servants are subject to compulsory state fingerprint registration and compulsory state genomic registration in the cases and in the manner established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.label: Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 1. A civil servant may not remain in the civil service in the event of:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 1) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 2) being sentenced, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force, to a punishment precluding the performance of official duties in a state service (civil service) position, or having a conviction that has not been removed or expunged in the manner established by federal law;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining access to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal law, if the duties of the civil service position sought by the citizen or held by the civil servant involve use of such information;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 4) an illness preventing entry into or performance of the civil service, confirmed by a medical organization's opinion. The procedure for medical examinations, the list of such illnesses and the form of the medical organization's opinion are established by a federal executive body authorized by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 5) close blood or marital relationship (parents, spouses, children, brothers, sisters, and the brothers, sisters, parents and children of spouses and spouses of children) with a civil servant, where holding the civil service position entails direct subordination or accountability of one to the other, except for civil service positions in executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation authorized in the field of forest relations in areas with low rural population density and in remote and hard-to-reach localities;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 7) possession of citizenship (nationality) of a foreign State, or a residence permit or other document confirming the citizen's right to permanent residence in a foreign State, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 8) submission, upon entry into and/or during civil service, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information purporting to confirm compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements whose violation precludes holding a civil service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information showing noncompliance with such restrictions, prohibitions and requirements;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 9) failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations required by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, and information on expenditure required by Federal Law No. 230-ФЗ of 3 December 2012 ‘On Monitoring the Correspondence between the Expenditure and Income of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons’; submission of knowingly incomplete information, except in cases established by federal laws, or submission of knowingly inaccurate information;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 10) loss of the employer's representative's trust in the civil servant for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or failure to perform duties established for combating corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 11) being found, in accordance with a conscription commission's opinion, not to have performed compulsory military service without lawful grounds (except citizens who performed military service under contract), for 10 years from expiry of the period for appealing that opinion to the conscription commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation; or, if that opinion and/or the decision of the constituent entity's conscription commission on the citizen's appeal against it were challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of a court decision finding that the citizen's rights were not violated in issuing the opinion and/or the decision of the constituent entity's conscription commission on the appeal;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 12) failure to submit information provided for by Article 20.2 of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 13) acquisition of foreign agent status.
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 2. Restrictions connected with civil service other than those specified in part 1 of this Article are established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 16. Restrictions connected with the civil service
units.text: 3. Liability for failure to comply with the restrictions provided for by part 1 of this Article is established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 16

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.label: Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 1. In connection with civil service, a civil servant is prohibited from:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 1) repealed from 1 January 2015. — Federal Law No. 431-ФЗ of 22.12.2014;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 2) holding a civil service position in the event of:
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: а) election or appointment to a state office, except in the cases established by part two of Article 4 of Federal Constitutional Law No. 4-ФКЗ of 6 November 2020 ‘On the Government of the Russian Federation’ and part nine of Article 12 of Federal Law No. 437-ФЗ of 22 December 2020 ‘On the Sirius Federal Territory’;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: б) election to an elected office in a local self-government body;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: в) election to a paid elected office in a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 3) participating in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: а) unpaid participation in managing a political party or trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body; participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real-estate owners;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: б) unpaid participation in managing a nonprofit organization (other than participation in managing a political party or trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing-construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real-estate owners), with permission from the employer's representative obtained in the manner established by a normative legal act of the state body;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: в) unpaid participation, as a member of its collegiate management body, in managing a commercial organization belonging to a state corporation, state company or public-law company, more than 50 per cent of whose shares (interests) are owned by that state corporation, state company or public-law company, in the manner established by normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation or of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation governing such participation, unless otherwise established by federal constitutional laws or federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17
